title: Generic-point unit on locally constant module sheaves
statement: Let V be a normal integral scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois], g:Spec κ(η) -> V its generic-point stalk morphism, Λ any commutative ring, and G a locally constant sheaf of Λ-modules on the small etale site. The actual adjunction unit G -> g_*g^*G is an isomorphism. Locally constant means etale locally a constant module sheaf; the values need not be finite. The unit is that of the etale inverse-image/direct-image adjunction.

proof.text: The normal generic constant theorem, in its proved module-valued form isIso_unit_constantSheaf_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint, gives invertibility of the generic-point unit on every constant Λ-module sheaf.

For any etale map w:W -> V, form its pullback square with g. Etale base change is an isomorphism. Its unit equation map_unit_baseChangeMap_app shows that the pulled-back unit is invertible exactly when the unit for the base-changed morphism is invertible on w^*G. For constant G the former follows from the previous step; w^* preserves constant values, so the latter holds for every constant module sheaf on W.

Choose an etale cover trivializing G. Naturality of the local unit transports its invertibility from constant values to each w^*G. The same unit/base-change equation gives invertibility of w^* of the original unit. Use upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and the jointly surjective localizationRestriction isomorphism detector to conclude. This avoids any identification of the generic fibre of W and also covers empty members of the trivializing cover.
